title: My Cat
text:
I have a cat. Her name is Mimi. She is white. She is very small. She has big eyes. Her eyes are blue. She lives with me. She likes milk. She drinks milk every day. She likes fish too.

She eats fish with me. She sleeps on my bed. She sleeps near me. She plays with a ball. The ball is red. She runs fast. She jumps high. I like Mimi. Mimi likes me. We are good friends. We play every day. She is cute. I love her.

title: Red Apples
text:
I like apples. They are red. They are sweet. I eat one every day. My mother buys apples. She buys five apples. We put them in a box. The box is on the table.

My sister likes apples too. She eats two apples. My brother likes bananas. He does not like apples. Today is Sunday. We eat apples together. We drink water too. Apples are good. Apples are sweet. I love red apples. They make me happy. We eat fruit every morning.

title: My School Bag
text:
I have a school bag. It is blue. It is new. I take it to school. It has two books. It has three pencils. It has one pen. It has a red box. The box is small.

I put lunch in it. My lunch is rice. I love my bag. It is big and strong. My friend has a bag too. Her bag is pink. My bag is blue. We go to school. We walk together. We sing songs. School is fun. I like my bag.

title: A Sunny Day
text:
Today is sunny. The sky is blue. The sun is big. I go to the park. I go with my dad. We walk to the park. Birds sing in the trees. Flowers are pink and yellow.

We sit on the grass. We drink cold water. I run in the park. I play with a ball. My dad smiles at me. We see a white dog. The dog runs fast. We eat ice cream. It is sweet and cold. I love sunny days. They make me happy.

title: My Lunch
text:
It is twelve o'clock. I eat lunch. I eat with my mom. We sit at the table. I eat rice. I eat eggs. I eat carrots. Carrots are orange. Eggs are yellow and white. I drink hot soup. The soup is good.

My mom eats bread. She eats cheese. She drinks milk. I love lunch time. Lunch is yummy. We talk and smile. We wash our hands. We clean the table. The room is clean. I am happy. Mom is happy too.

title: Two Dogs
text:
I have two dogs. One dog is big. One dog is small. The big dog is black. The small dog is brown. Their names are Coco and Pipi. Coco is big. Pipi is small. They live with me.

They like bones. They eat bones every day. They drink water. They run in the garden. They play with me. Coco runs fast. Pipi walks slow. They sleep in a small house. The house is red. I wash them on Sunday. I love Coco and Pipi.

title: Happy Birthday
text:
Today is my birthday. I am seven years old. My family sings a song. Happy birthday to me. I have a big cake. The cake is pink. It has six red candles. I blow the candles. We clap our hands.

I open my gifts. One gift is a book. One gift is a blue pen. My dad gives me a ball. The ball is green. We eat cake together. The cake is sweet. I drink apple juice. My friends smile. I smile too. I am very happy.
